records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, River Labs!
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Glad to have River Labs on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *River Labs* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone and zero tickets; three Wrenfield outbound emails (email:84309487, email:90498a5c, email:2cb667a6) drew no customer reply at all, suggesting low engagement. Starter plan, 8 days left. Self-serve activation possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: One first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

I haven't heard back, so I won't keep filling your inbox. If Wrenfield is still on your list for River Labs, the simplest starting point is one real project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you on a short call this week 
can work around your schedule.

Best,
Nadia
